```{r, include = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

plot_theme <- readRDS("scripts/plot_theme.RDS")

```


```{r, include = F}
hat_by_pbt_chk <- readRDS("output/hat_by_pbt_fromR.RDS")

hat_by_pbt_spreadsheet <- read.csv("data_inputs/hat_by_pbt_check.csv")
hat_by_pbt_spreadsheet <- hat_by_pbt_spreadsheet %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("F", "M", "jack"), names_to = "Sex", values_to = "spreadsheet_count")

check_output_hatbypbt <- full_join(hat_by_pbt_chk, hat_by_pbt_spreadsheet, 
                                   by = c("Sex", "brood_year", "RelSite"))  

hat_by_pbt_plot <- ggplot(check_output_hatbypbt, aes(x = spreadsheet_count, y = total)) + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "grey50") + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Original method") + 
  ylab("New method") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2000)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2000)) + 
  ggtitle("")
  
```


```{r, include = F}
final_estimates <- readRDS("output/final_estimates.RDS")

final_totals <- read.csv("data_inputs/final_totals_check.csv")
final_totals <- final_totals %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("F", "M", "jack"), names_to = "Sex", values_to = "spreadsheet_count")


check_final <- full_join(final_estimates, final_totals, by = c("Sex", "RelSite", "brood_year", "age", "rearing" , "origin"))

check_final <- check_final %>%
  mutate(diff = total - spreadsheet_count) %>%
  mutate(pct_diff = (diff/spreadsheet_count)*100)

summary(check_final$diff)

raw_diff_hist <- ggplot(check_final, aes(x = diff)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill = "grey", color = "black", binwidth = 5)  + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Difference between estimates") + 
  ylab("Count") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-50, 150)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 125))
  
#My method seems to have slightly underestimated wild fish abundance
#need to look at where things went wrong
#likely somewhere in age assignment and particularly age assignment for outage expansion fish


final_total_plot <- ggplot(check_final, aes(x = spreadsheet_count, y = total, group = origin)) + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, aes(fill = origin), color = "black") + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Original method") + 
  ylab("New method") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2000)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2000))


summary_table <- check_final %>%
  group_by(origin) %>%
  summarise('New method' = round(sum(total, na.rm = T)), 'Original method' = sum(spreadsheet_count, na.rm = T))
  

check_final %>%
  group_by(origin) %>%
  summarise('New method' = sum(total, na.rm = T), 'Original method' = sum(spreadsheet_count, na.rm = T))
  

hist_by_origin <- ggplot(check_final, aes(x = diff, group = origin)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = origin), color = "black", binwidth = 5)  + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Difference between estimates") + 
  ylab("Count") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-50, 150)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100)) + 
  facet_wrap(~origin) + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70", color = "black"), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12), 
        panel.spacing = unit(10, "mm")) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed")

```


```{r, echo = F}
knitr::kable(summary_table, 
             caption = "Estimates of Snake River fall Chinook escapement to Lower Granite Dam by origin produced by the original and new method.")
```


```{r hat-by-pbt, fig.cap = "Estimates of Snake River fall Chinook escapement to Lower Granite Dam for hatchery-assigned fish by age, sex, and release group. Estimates account for fallback and re-ascension, but do not account for trap outage periods.", echo=F, warning = F}
hat_by_pbt_plot
```

```{r final-total, fig.width = 10, fig.cap = "Estimates of Snake River fall Chinook escapement to Lower Granite Dam by age, sex, and release group. Estimates account for fallback and re-ascension and trap outage, including an expansion for the end of the run. Estiamtes account for fallback and re-ascension and trap outage periods.", echo = F, warning = F}
final_total_plot
```


```{r diff-hist, fig.cap = "The difference in the estimates of escapement by age, sex, and release group between the original and new method. Estiamtes account for fallback and re-ascension and trap outage periods.", echo=F, warning=FALSE}
raw_diff_hist
```


```{r hist-by-origin, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7, fig.cap = "The difference in the estimates of escapement by age, sex, and release group between the original and new method. Estiamtes account for fallback and re-ascension and trap outage periods.", echo = F, warning = F}
hist_by_origin
```
